/init  So, we'll be working on the take-home project for Cognyx. The goal right now is to set up the repository. You'll have access to the usual skills like GStack, and all the documentations should be put in the Obsidian vault at this specific location: /Users/pierre.delabelliere/Obsidian/pierre-dlb/cognyx-takehome 
You'll find a brief as well as a quick intro. In this folder, you'll be able to add all the documentation you need. The goal is that all the trade-offs, all the discussions, the technical but also business decisions, are tracked there. Every time you make changes, please state them in a handoff Markdown file that you will have to create. And all agents should work there.

Feel free to ask questions if you need.
I’ll inspect the repository and the Obsidian brief, then set up repository guidance and a handoff log for future work. I’ll also check whether GStack is available locally.

The repository is a minimal Python scaffold. The brief calls for a working BOM reuse demo, with a recommended four-hour preparation limit and a visible record of AI-assisted work.

I’ll make the Obsidian folder the source of truth for decisions, discussions, and handoffs, and add instructions that every agent must follow. GStack is installed under `~/.claude/skills`; I’ve located it for future use.

+# Agent instructions
+
+## Purpose and current state
+
+This is the Cognyx Forward Deployed Engineer take-home project: a small working
+tool that ingests synthetic multi-variant BOM data and technical notes, normalizes
+them, and explains sub-assembly reuse opportunities and data inconsistencies.
+The brief recommends no more than four hours of preparation. Favor a working,
+well-prioritized demonstration with evidence and clear limitations.
+
+The repository currently contains a Python scaffold, not an implemented demo.
+Do not describe planned capabilities as shipped.
+
+## Documentation is in Obsidian
+
+Repository: `/Users/pierre.delabelliere/projects/cognyx-takehome`
+
+Canonical documentation directory:
+`/Users/pierre.delabelliere/Obsidian/pierre-dlb/cognyx-takehome`
+
+At the start of every task, read these notes in that directory:
+
+1. `00 - Intro.md`
+2. `01 - Brief.md`
+3. `02 - Project Hub.md`
+4. `HANDOFF.md`, starting with the latest entry
+5. Relevant entries in `03 - Decisions.md` and `04 - Discussions.md`
+
+Keep product and technical documentation, plans, trade-offs, discussion outcomes,
+business assumptions, and demo preparation in that directory. Use Markdown and
+Obsidian wiki links between notes. Preserve the original intro and brief.
+The repository README is a short evaluator-facing entry point; keep agent
+instructions here. Do not create a competing documentation tree in the repository.
+
+Record decisions in `03 - Decisions.md` with context, alternatives, rationale,
+consequences, and status. Distinguish user decisions, agent implementation choices,
+and proposals awaiting discussion. Record consequential discussions and unresolved
+questions in `04 - Discussions.md`, including both technical and business matters.
+Never present an inferred preference or a fictional metric as a confirmed fact.
+
+## Mandatory handoff for every change
+
+After each coherent change set, and before handing work back, append an entry to
+the vault's `HANDOFF.md`. Documentation-only changes count. Use the template in
+that file and record:
+
+- Timestamp with timezone, agent identity, and task/user intent.
+- What changed, with exact repository paths or vault note names.
+- Why it changed, with links to decisions and discussion outcomes.
+- Commands/checks run and actual results; explicitly identify untested work.
+- Known limitations, blockers, and the concrete next step.
+- Git status/commit reference if applicable; do not invent commit history.
+
+Every agent working on this project follows this workflow. If multiple agents
+are assigned, give each the vault path and a bounded area of ownership. Coordinate
+appends to shared notes so that no entry is overwritten. Keep code in the repository
+and documentation in the vault. Do not delegate unless requested or authorized by
+the current task's governing instructions.
+
+The vault is outside the default repository write sandbox. Read access does not
+imply tool-level write permission. Prepare the exact documentation changes first,
+then use the environment's approval mechanism if needed to write them. If access
+is blocked, report the pending handoff explicitly; do not silently skip it or
+claim it was saved.
+
+## Development workflow
+
+- Inspect the working tree before editing; preserve existing user changes.
+- Keep changes small and inspectable, and record material AI-assisted choices.
+- Follow the existing Python package layout under `src/cognyx_takehome/`.
+- The scaffold pins Python 3.9 in `.python-version`, declares Python >=3.9,
+  and uses `uv_build`. Revisit runtime/tooling choices explicitly before changing them.
+- The current scaffold smoke check is:
+  `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c 'from cognyx_takehome import main; main()'`.
+- Once dependencies are installed with `uv sync`, the declared entry point is
+  `uv run cognyx-takehome`. Do not treat an import smoke check as packaging validation.
+- No test suite or lint configuration exists yet. Add meaningful checks with the
+  implemented behavior; record the commands here when the workflow changes.
+- Use synthetic data for the exercise. Preserve source references and make
+  normalization, uncertainty, and inconsistency findings explainable.
+- Distinguish observed reuse from candidate reusability requiring engineering
+  validation. Label invented costs, metrics, and savings as assumptions.
+- Account for the brief's eventual in-network deployment constraint when making
+  architecture decisions; distinguish demo behavior from production proposals.
+
+## Skills and delivery
+
+GStack is installed locally at `/Users/pierre.delabelliere/gstack`, exposed through
+`/Users/pierre.delabelliere/.claude/skills/gstack` and sibling skill directories.
+Read the applicable `SKILL.md` before using a skill and use it when relevant to the
+task. Do not assume a slash command is registered in every agent runtime. Keep
+project documentation and handoffs in the vault even when a skill has a different
+default artifact location. Do not copy or reinstall the skill suite unnecessarily.
+
+The brief eventually requires a shareable Git repository, short README, AI-work
+trace, a pre-session email, and a demo. The private Obsidian vault alone is not a
+shareable submission. Decide and record how to include a suitable trace when
+preparing delivery. Email preparation is distinct from authorization to send it.
*** Add File: /Users/pierre.delabelliere/projects/cognyx-takehome/CLAUDE.md

+# Cognyx take-home — project hub
+
+## Start here
+
+- [[00 - Intro]] — original workspace context.
+- [[01 - Brief]] — original exercise and deliverables.
+- [[03 - Decisions]] — technical and business decisions, alternatives, and trade-offs.
+- [[04 - Discussions]] — discussion outcomes, assumptions, and open questions.
+- [[HANDOFF]] — chronological record of every change set and where to resume.
+
+Code: `/Users/pierre.delabelliere/projects/cognyx-takehome`
+
+Shared agent instructions: `/Users/pierre.delabelliere/projects/cognyx-takehome/AGENTS.md`.
+All agents read those instructions and append a handoff after every change set.
+This vault directory is the canonical home for project documentation.
+
+## Outcome from the brief
+
+Demonstrate that Cognyx can make sense of a synthetic export representing dirty
+Alstom PLM/ERP data and provide evidence of sub-assembly reuse across train variants,
+candidate reuse opportunities, and inconsistencies.
+
+The fictional pilot lasts three weeks at Valenciennes. The brief recommends at
+most four hours of home preparation. This is a prioritization constraint, not a
+claim that a preparation timer has already been running or measured.
+
+Bruno Maréchal, Engineering Director and sponsor, needs a concise value story.
+Thomas Lindqvist, lead data engineer, needs explainability, maintainability, and
+credible data handling. Kaïs, Cognyx Deployment Strategist, owns the relationship.
+The eventual production deployment must keep data inside Alstom's network.
+
+## Deliverables to prepare
+
+- A small working tool: synthetic multi-variant BOM and bilingual free-text notes,
+  normalization into a simple entity model, reuse analysis, inconsistency evidence.
+- A shareable Git repository with a short README and a visible trace of AI-assisted work.
+- A short pre-session email describing what was built, what it proves, production
+  gaps, and the repository link. Sending remains a separate user-authorized action.
+- A walkthrough of one or two previously shipped projects or AI-assisted setups.
+- A meeting: 10 minutes of shipped work with Cognyx, about 20 minutes in role with
+  Bruno and Thomas, about 10 minutes on the repository and AI setup, then 20 minutes
+  of out-of-role Q&A.
+
+## Current state
+
+Initialization only. The repository has an existing Python package scaffold using
+`uv_build`; its only behavior is printing a greeting. Agent instructions and a
+minimal README now describe the workflow. There is no dataset, implemented analysis,
+UI, test suite, or production deployment yet.
+
+The installed system Python is 3.9.6 and `uv` is 0.12.13. The import smoke check
+passed. Dependency installation and the packaged entry point have not been tested.
+GStack skill files were found locally; no GStack review or QA workflow has run.
+
+## Next working session
+
+Choose one demonstrable client question and the smallest end-to-end workflow that
+answers it with traceable evidence. Record the interface, entity model, synthetic
+data cases, acceptance checks, and business assumptions before expanding scope.
+See [[04 - Discussions]] for unresolved choices.
+
+All invented figures must be marked as synthetic or assumed. Observed reuse and
+potential engineering compatibility must be presented separately.
*** Add File: /private/tmp/cognyx-init-docs/03 - Decisions.md
+# Decisions
+
+Record material technical and business choices here. Keep proposals distinct from
+accepted choices. Supersede previous entries explicitly rather than erasing history.
+
+## D-001 — Canonical documentation and handoffs
+
+- Date: 2026-09-14.
+- Status: accepted; explicit user instruction.
+- Context: the user wants every agent's technical and business reasoning to remain
+  available for later review.
+- Decision: maintain documentation in
+  `/Users/pierre.delabelliere/Obsidian/pierre-dlb/cognyx-takehome`, including one shared
+  `HANDOFF.md` updated after every coherent change set. Keep code in the repository.
+- Alternatives: repository-only documentation or separate per-agent stores.
+- Rationale: a single Obsidian location makes decisions and handoffs discoverable
+  without fragmenting context between agents.
+- Consequences: every agent needs vault access. Writes may require sandbox approval.
+  The private vault does not automatically satisfy the brief's shareable AI-work
+  trace; delivery needs an explicit treatment of that requirement.
+- Related discussion: [[04 - Discussions#2026-09-14 — Initialization request]].
+
+## D-002 — Shared repository instructions
+
+- Date: 2026-09-14.
+- Status: implemented; agent setup choice within the initialization request.
+- Context: future agents must consistently discover the brief and document changes.
+- Decision: use repository-root `AGENTS.md` as the shared workflow, with `CLAUDE.md`
+  pointing to it and a minimal evaluator-facing README.
+- Alternatives: copy full instructions into each agent's configuration or rely on
+  conversation context alone.
+- Rationale: one instruction source reduces drift and survives new sessions.
+- Consequences: task documentation stays in Obsidian; the repository retains the
+  small operational entry points needed by agents and eventual evaluators.
+
+## D-003 — Preserve the scaffold during initialization
+
+- Date: 2026-09-14.
+- Status: implemented; agent scope choice, not a final architecture decision.
+- Context: the user's current request is repository setup. A Python scaffold
+  already exists with a Python 3.9 pin, Python >=3.9 metadata, and `uv_build`.
+- Decision: preserve the runtime, package layout, dependencies, and application
+  behavior while establishing instructions and documentation.
+- Alternatives: choose a UI/framework now, replace the scaffold, or add speculative
+  dependencies and tests before defining the demo.
+- Rationale: preserve existing work and spend the exercise's short preparation
+  budget on decisions tied to demonstrable client value.
+- Consequences: interface, data model, runtime suitability, and implementation
+  tooling remain open. The greeting smoke check is not evidence of BOM capability
+  or a validated installation.
+
+## Template for subsequent decisions
+
+```markdown
+## D-NNN — Title
+
+- Date:
+- Status: proposed / accepted / implemented / superseded by D-NNN.
+- Authority: user instruction / agent choice / pending discussion.
+- Context and evidence:
+- Decision:
+- Alternatives considered:
+- Rationale, including business impact:
+- Trade-offs and consequences:
+- Validation or revisit condition:
+- Related discussion/handoff:
+```
*** Add File: /private/tmp/cognyx-init-docs/04 - Discussions.md
+# Discussions
+
+Capture consequential discussions, their outcomes, and unresolved questions.
+Summarize reasoning faithfully; do not invent user approval or record hidden agent

+- User intent: initialize the Cognyx take-home repository; read the existing intro
+  and brief; keep documentation, technical and business decisions, trade-offs, and
+  agent handoffs in the specified Obsidian directory.
+- Explicit requirement: every change must be recorded in a handoff Markdown file,
+  and all agents must use the shared documentation location.
+- Tooling context: the user mentioned usual skills such as GStack. Local inspection

+  It is not listed among this session's registered skills, but its files can be
+  read when a relevant workflow is needed. No installation or workflow was run.
+- Outcome: shared repository instructions, a minimal README, a project hub,
+  decision and discussion logs, and a mandatory handoff file.
+- Decisions: [[03 - Decisions#D-001 — Canonical documentation and handoffs]],
+  [[03 - Decisions#D-002 — Shared repository instructions]], and
+  [[03 - Decisions#D-003 — Preserve the scaffold during initialization]].
+
+## Open questions for product and implementation work
+
+These are unmade choices, not blockers to repository initialization.
+
+| Topic | Question to resolve | Why it matters |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| Demonstration | Which concrete reuse/inconsistency example should anchor the client meeting? | Keeps the build focused on evidence and sponsor value. |
+| Interface | CLI and report, small web app, or another minimal interface? | Affects implementation time and live-demo clarity. |
+| Model and matching | What proves actual reuse, and what only suggests candidate reusability? | Prevents unsupported compatibility claims. |
+| Business value | Which synthetic baseline and value measures will be shown? | Makes the value story explicit without implying measured customer savings. |
+| Runtime | Keep Python 3.9 or change it before implementing? | Needs a deliberate compatibility and maintenance choice. |
+| Delivery | Where will the repo be shared, and how will an appropriate AI-work trace be included? | Evaluators cannot rely on this private local vault. |
+| Shipped work | Which one or two existing projects or setups will Pierre show? | Separate preparation requirement in the brief. |
+
+## Template for subsequent discussions
+
+```markdown
+## YYYY-MM-DD — Topic
+
+- Participants/source:
+- Question or user request:
+- Facts and constraints:
+- Options and trade-offs discussed:
+- Outcome: decided / proposed / unresolved.
+- Decision links:

from pathlib import Path
import re
staged = Path('/private/tmp/cognyx-init-docs')
vault = Path('/Users/pierre.delabelliere/Obsidian/pierre-dlb/cognyx-takehome')
